description.value: An Esso fuel and convenience station in Dawson Creek, a key service node on the Alaska Highway corridor in northeastern BC. The station features an air tower, making it a practical stop for cyclists needing to inflate tires, as well as an ATM on site. As a full-service fuel stop with a convenience store, it is one of the more useful resupply points for long-distance tourers passing through town.
